runSummary.note: Real 16 Sep 19:30 sweep. Thirteen independent source families were actually queried: Profesia, direct company/public careers, LinkedIn Jobs, Worki, Kariera, Brigada.sk, Praca za rohom, Pretlak/StartupJobs, Upwork, WordPress public jobs, Reddit/WordPress communities, public Facebook indexing, and broader direct-career discovery. Kaufland Service & Support remains a current BA-area support candidate. LinkedIn surfaced SupportYourApp remote technical support but C1 English is a hard mismatch. SmartBase Bratislava currently exposes a remote Medior Frontend-FullStack role, but the hard-development stack is outside target. Upwork surfaced a WooCommerce product-listing role at $10-30/h that operationally fits well and explicitly allows ChatGPT for Dutch text, but it is three weeks old, already has 20-50 proposals, 1 hire and 4 interviews, so it is not promoted as a meaningful new alert. Facebook produced 0 concrete publicly verifiable posts.

masterBacklogAdditions.title: Marketplace competition decay score
masterBacklogAdditions.detail: For freelance listings, combine listing age, proposal count, interviews and existing hires into one decay score so excellent skill matches are automatically deprioritized once realistic win probability collapses.

masterBacklogAdditions.title: AI-assisted language task separation
masterBacklogAdditions.detail: Distinguish jobs where a foreign language is required for live human communication from product-copy/data-entry work where the client explicitly permits AI translation or ChatGPT; this prevents unnecessarily rejecting e-commerce work that is feasible with assisted text production.

policy.contentAgeVsVerificationAge: updatedAt/contentUpdatedAt describes data-content age; sourceVerificationAt describes when sources were actually checked; each job verifiedAt describes that job's evidence age.
policy.promotion: No timestamp-only freshness. New LIVE promotion requires active full-detail evidence, location eligibility, confidence >= 80 and no known hard eligibility gate.
policy.discovery: List/search resurfacing can create a candidate but never verifiedAt or LIVE promotion by itself.
policy.failClosed: Existing LIVE jobs are not removed merely because a sweep did not rediscover them. No unsafe write to jobs-data, job-sources or MASTER is attempted where full round-trip content cannot be guaranteed.
